arChildNodes.szComment: This is a CHILD Rathma. There should be a sense of childlike curiosity and excitement to his delivery.
Taking it all in, Rathma's head darts around.
Rathma thinks for a moment, then gazes up at Inarius.
Inarius sees the desperation to understand in Rathma's eyes. He takes a beat to find the right words.
Rathma gazes up at Inarius, a glimmer of confidence showing in his posture as Inarius' words sink in.
